copyHelp: If X does not open, copy the text and URL to create your post.
copied: Copied. Review and publish your post on X.
copyManual: Select the text and copy it manually.
rankingUnavailable: Rankings are currently unavailable. Your result remains on screen.
rankingSendFailed: Could not submit your score. Your result remains on screen.
rankingLoadFailed: Could not load rankings. Your result remains on screen.
nameDisclosure: If you enter a name, your name and score will be public in the rankings. You can play with this blank.
guestResult: You played without a name. This score will not be public.
scorePending: Your score is pending. The same result will be retried when the connection returns.
intro: Collect loot to upgrade your aircraft and clear all 30 waves.
goalRule: Defeat enemies, collect loot, and upgrade your aircraft to clear all 30 waves.
controlsRule: Drag on the screen to move your aircraft. It fires automatically.
lootRule: Move your aircraft close to loot (🌰) to collect it.
upgradesRule: Loot grants experience. Each level grants one random upgrade from 7 types, excluding those at their cap. Your first upgrade is an attack upgrade.
wavesRule: There are 30 waves, with a boss every 5 waves. Defeat the wave 30 boss to clear the game.
telegraphRule: A boss’s red lines and circles warn of incoming attacks. Move to safety while they are visible.
retireRule: Use Retire in the upper right to end your run. Retired runs are not submitted to the rankings.
retireWarning: This run will not be submitted to the rankings. Retire now?
shareDescription: Defeat enemies, collect loot, and upgrade your aircraft through 30 waves in this vertical scrolling shooter.
storageFailed: This device cannot save the record. To avoid losing the result, do not reload; retry when saving is available.
